charge_mapping.instructions: Every typed instruction maps one-to-one to its neutral path and UTF-8 span; one continuation before any effect, even on refusal.
charge_mapping.kernel: ctx.kernel_call precharges tariff and batch chunks; batch buffer is never rebound/charged twice. Snapshot handle: 32 logical bytes.
charge_mapping.lifetime: Retention until run end, independent of Python GC. Pure checking/source admission/label bookkeeping has no additional neutral charge.
charge_mapping.loops_calls: Each loop test including final false: one step. Call and return: one each. Recursive logical frames: 16 bytes before entering. Parameters and loop aliases retain canonical size.
charge_mapping.ordering: Interrupt, steps, kernel cost, memory, output; unsuccessful later charge retains earlier successful charges.
charge_mapping.output: Canonical exact plan/output before emit, publish, capture, workspace write and top-level return; internal returns have no output charge.

consumed_inputs: Host ledger of workspace value/block/parts, pick records and previous exact output hash, expanded into the binding key. Inputs/profile/author are frozen host data, never source-minted authority.
edition: rt1-throwaway-prefix-v1; own typed interpreter, Python standard library exact integers

execution_contract.runtime: Static type/effect/upper-bound checks plus own immutable value labels and executed branch/loop context. Gates use actual labels; they must fit the static bound.
execution_contract.separation: Select preview authority from transitive effects; otherwise remove it. Preflight state-read effects through shared policy. Persist read_state and profile/parts; read also denotes the policy's fixed caps row.
execution_contract.source: Parse pinned UTF-8 text; type/effect check and execute that same tree through typed IR. Full archive and module closure are bound; no eval or host code generation.
execution_contract.static: Join both branches, loop fixed point, context-insensitive call-site fixed point and sequential storage summaries. Check the inferred gate at every executed effect.
execution_contract.termination: Ordinary data/control dependencies only. No stop-sensitive or accumulated-emission repair.

provenance_contract.rule: Only trusted adapter constructs blocks. All data/control/capture dependencies and aggregate parts join; stored blocks remain dependencies. Named setup and fixed picks retain host records.
